lines.code: int max; /* maximum length seen so far */

lines.explanation: Initially, the current longest length is set to zero, until a longer one is found.

As long as there is new input to search, the outer loop continues on to the next line.  It processes each line by running an inner loop.  See function below for code that runs whenever "getline" is called.  In this case, the limit is set to "MAXLINE" .
Every time the outer, searching loop runs, the inner loop compares values, then processes the line only if the present line is longer than the current maximum, using an inner loop.
When a greater value is found in the next line, the new value is placed into "max" the variable that stores the current maximum.
